headline: City's Semenyo out eight weeks; Arsenal-Bayern looms
paragraphs: Manchester City's Antoine Semenyo will be out for up to eight weeks with a knee injury sustained against Ipswich, manager Enzo Maresca confirmed ahead of Tuesday's Champions League game against AEK Athens. Sky Sports, the Guardian and BBC Sport each carried the story independently, and BBC Sport added that Erling Haaland is also a doubt for the same match, leaving City short up front. Real Madrid, separately, beat Sevilla, with Kylian Mbappe among the standout performers, according to Sky Sports.

Arsenal meet Bayern Munich in the Champions League on Wednesday. The Guardian reports Bayern arrive in form after putting six goals past RB Leipzig, and quotes defender Ezri Konsa anticipating a personal duel with Harry Kane. Sky Sports pundit Paul Merson said Arsenal's recent loss to Brighton had rattled the team and predicted they will not beat Bayern -- his opinion, not a confirmed outcome. Separately, BBC's gossip column reports Kane is close to signing a new Bayern contract, a claim no other outlet has corroborated.

At Liverpool, BBC Sport describes Ronald Araujo, who arrived from Barcelona, as having impressed as a stopgap defensive option. Interest in Bournemouth's Alex Scott has run through BBC's gossip column on multiple days and was echoed by FourFourTwo, which reported the pursuit intensifying after Liverpool's comeback win over Brentford -- still unconfirmed by either club. At Real Madrid, BBC and FourFourTwo both report that Sergio Ramos, 40 and without a club since December, could make a surprise return to La Liga with his former side; no deal has been confirmed.
